repaired.name: Scenario
repaired.script:
t1 = (#Study_Temp).temperatureSensor_temperature
delay(20 MIN)
t2 = (#Study_Temp).temperatureSensor_temperature
diff = t2 - t1
if (diff >= 3) {
    (#Study_AC).airConditioner_setAirConditionerMode("cool")
}

diagnosis.summary: The JoI adds an unnecessary absolute-value correction (lines 5-7) that computes diff = t1 - t2 when diff < 0, which the IR does not have. This causes an extra action to be emitted when t2 - t1 < 0 but |t2 - t1| >= 3, violating the IR's exact predicate. F2 shows IR emitted no action at 1200000ms while JoI emitted one. F3 confirms the extra if-block exists in the candidate.
diagnosis.change_summary: Removed the unnecessary absolute-value correction block (if diff < 0) that modifies the diff calculation. The IR specifies only t2 - t1 >= 3 without any absolute-value logic. Preserving the exact predicate ensures the JoI matches the IR's action semantics.
